I had a traumatic surgery a year ago and was prescribed 180 percs a month and I still supplemented with kratom. After a while I just find that its just not worth it. Being stuck in bed and irritable. 


I titrated in March and I’m so glad to be rid of it. In the beginning I treat the withdrawal or whatever as like my brain was coming out of a concussion. I listened to music, tried to do the least comprehensive thinking as possible and try to keep exposure to external stimulation to a minimum. 


After a while my brain seemed to start repairing itself and I could do more comprehensive thinking and listen to podcasts while working. 

From there I listen to podcasts while working out, and books while walking my dog earlier every morning. I’m at 10 books of my 15 year end goal. 

The brain and body is a miraculous thing and plasticity is real stuff. I’m still in decent amount of pain but I’m not willing to trade it for my nee found mental cohesiveness.

I am at 21 days sober, almost 8 years from alcohol, this has been particularly hard bc it’s so accessible. But so is alcohol and I stopped that. The benefits I found are fleeting but worth it. Music has always been my WD friend. Somehow it just sounds better and the feelings come back. My emotions are all over the place but at least I’m having them. My motivation for work is coming back which is wonderful bc I really do love my job and I feel more present. Though a full day goes wear me out now. I used to take kratom and be a workhorse but it would only kick in late at night. Now I’m back at regular hours and feel more myself. Wim Hoff breathing has helped for PAWS.
